messages.author: a603720932b01c5e
messages.subject: Problem with mrds 2.1.6 in Distance 6.2
parts:
Hello,

I have been having trouble running MRDS analyses from within Distance 6.2 with R 3.1.1 installed in two different machines running WinXP and Win8. I keep getting the following error message, no matter what I have tried (reinstalling both Distance and R, rolling back to previous releases, etc):

Error in Summary.factor(c(3L, 2L, 2L), na.rm = FALSE) : 

  sum not meaningful for factors

Calls: dht ... eval -> eval -> tapply -> lapply -> FUN -> Summary.factor

In addition: Warning message:

In Ops.factor(size, pdot) : / not meaningful for factors

Execution halted

 

Could anyone help out please?

Thank you in advance,

Yiannis

messages.author: a603720932b01c5e
messages.subject: Re: Problem with mrds 2.1.6 in Distance 6.2
parts:
I just found out that it was the size factor covariate name ("size") that causing the problems. When I changed it's name to something else, everything worked fine. 

Cheers,

Y.
